summary: BEVEST ASA operates as an investment firm, primarily investing in companies within industrial production, seafood, and property sectors. The company provides products and services through its portfolio companies, including machinery, mechanical services, automation, robotics, welding, surface treatment, assembly, and series production in industrial production. It develops and supplies universal protectors for tubulars in the oil and gas sector, energy-efficient insulation solutions for buildings, and circular packaging solutions such as expanded polystyrene products. The company offers fresh food packaging, collaborates in the supply of closed fish cages for aquaculture, and invests in industrial, logistics, and light industrial real estate. BEVEST ASA was formerly known as BEWI Invest ASA and changed its name to BEVEST ASA in June 2026. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Trondheim, Norway. BEVEST ASA operates as a subsidiary of Bekken Invest As.
